description: HS256 on an RSA-2048 and an oct key returns the oct key, never the asymmetric one; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): HS256 is served by an oct key only (RFC 7518 §3.2), so an asymmetric key is never returned for a symmetric alg (§7); member 1 has no alg, use (U = sig) or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
